classification: M04 is a shared scenario, all branch parameters are prospective design assumptions, not observations or measured effects.

frozen_m04.classification: All numbers except source_anchors are shared scenario assumptions, not bank observations or forecasts.

source_anchors.rules_locator: same PDF pp.10-12; knowledge/raw/Transcript.md 13:12-14:01 lines20-21,18:52-19:26 lines30-31

admission.team_size_in_each_cell: same natural size k=2..5 fixed before call; full-ceiling calculation sets k=5 in all 5 team cells; no manufactured fifth member
admission.single_person_path: one of five individual cells; matching cell and seat published before any effort; no automatic right to admission
admission.selection: published homogeneous work/opportunity cell; never admitted this year; rotation priority to not previously admitted in rotation register; witnessed lottery among equal priority before effort; team roster frozen before effort

guarantee.conditions: named employee component of pre-agreed additional useful improvement delivered, accepted by independent recipient, quality test passed; team overall failure does not revoke an accepted personal component; no rank or remaining fund test
guarantee.bank_dependency: an accepted controlled component still qualifies; if validation blocked, original conditional promise and full reserve survive until documented resolution, never quarter-end forfeiture

contest.team_split: equal integer shares; floor(pool/k) each, 1 R remainder in roster-ID order frozen before effort; team sizes equal within cell
contest.ties: prepublished within-cell anchors; compare total 0..9, then robustness, then cooperative transfer; exact remaining tie resolved by witnessed random draw of ordering, no extra places or awards
contest.appeals: Each of 300 admitted people can submit one base and one contest appeal: maximum600 inputs/quarter including all team voices, never assumed rare. HR structured intake3min/input, independent manager15min/input including reply, employee6min/input; consolidate team outcome only after reading all inputs. Contest rankings provisional until all appeals close; rerank same3 slots before vesting.
contest.post_final_error: preserve vested rights; record incident and freeze next calls pending separately approved remedy; no claim of robustness to unbounded repeated wrongful disbursement

promise_formula.team_max: a 5-person winning team: 5*5000+30000=55000 R total, not 5*(5000+30000)
promise_formula.reserve_for_unredeemed_R: 0.194 * all vested_or_conditional_max_R_not_yet_fulfilled, release only with evidence of non-occurrence of conditions or confirmed fulfillment; no double-count of same backing cash as free budget

calendar.first_month: day 1 charter with group/quality anchors/catalogue/cost; day 10 intent close; day 15 draw; day 20 eligibility check; day 25 named promises signed; effort begins only in month 2
calendar.second_month: employee components delivered and tested in paid work; full result accepted by last business day; award-related maximum stock order placed this month for next-month receipt, funded before promise
calendar.third_month: base verified within 5 working days of full dossier, R credited within next 5 working days; contest provisional day 15, appeals to day 20, decision day 23, final R day 25; all selected physical rewards delivered/receipt confirmed by last working day if employee chose current window
calendar.procurement: same M04 batch 100 per region, one-month lead, payment on receipt; January old/fixed demand ordered in month 0 and paid in month 1; December->January orders belong to next year
calendar.employee_deferral: voluntary choice or silence never forfeits R; reserve survives and future requested capacity must be rechecked, including all-new-R-in-December stress; bank failure never labelled voluntary deferral

resource_parameters.existing_admin_formula: 80 h/month +0.02*baskets + (1/30)*merch_units; merch_units=0.2*baskets; applies to full demanded fulfillment, not censored capacity
resource_parameters.double_effort_sensitivity: multiply all recurring and initial HR/manager/employee/IT hours by 2 including existing admin; capacity unchanged until replacement approved; procurement unchanged
resource_parameters.total_cost_boundary: procurement and logistics + all existing scenario admin + all branch labor; existing platform running cost unknown and additional to quoted total; cash and opportunity cost separated
resource_parameters.total_cost_comparability: Show separately 2400 h/year and 2.4m rub of useful improvement execution; remaining employee hours are procedure. Do not attribute net benefit or count ordinary work as zero for comparators; independent finance must compare same cost boundary.
resource_parameters.evaluation_allocation_locator: pilot.evaluation_allocation; all evaluation hours included in year1 full resource, monthly HR capacity includes month4 extra20h

virtual_rewards.no_netting: physical backing cannot simultaneously pay for HR/service replacement; catalogue lists virtual reward only with owner, quota, funded replacement and alternative

calculation.old_C_and_R_use: use old_annual_use * each opening personal balance; distribute uniformly unless January stress
calculation.conversion: old_R_presented + new_R_used converted R->C 1:1, then physically fulfilled; no direct R service in main scenario
calculation.C_transfer: gross transfers internal; consolidated net 0; not counted as issuance
calculation.closing: opening_C_plus_R + fixed_C + vested_R - confirmed_C_fulfillment - confirmed_direct_R_service; no write-off on failure
calculation.purchase: arrivals=100*ceil(max(0,demand-opening_inventory)/100) per region; arrivals in month m ordered m-1; ending_inventory=opening_inventory+arrivals-demand
calculation.capacity: full demand compared with region capacity, never censored; on fail physical delivery and debits are counterfactual, rights retained
calculation.admin_capacity: existing admin + monthly branch HR; test 220 h separately from regional physical caps
calculation.future_new_R_reserve: outstanding vested or conditional maximum R * (940*price_multiplier+30)/5000; use stress price if prospective prices known
calculation.all_old_max: initial 200m C+R physical exposure=38.8m rub, initial backing=0, no invented opening reserve

year2_rule: same fixed rules, newly approved fund maximum 8m only after backing check; year1 unredeemed personal R survive and fully reserved; unissued and unpromised F may expire; bank budget cash carry-forward is not assumed
launch_gate: model-feasible LOW96 area only with verified gross fixed events, old rights/orders/backing, region catalogue and capacities, labor ownership, protection of all new promised rights. CORE cash pass is not full new-fixed backing; no claim of actual readiness.

pilot.assignment: randomize 5 pre-matched pairs of comparable cells, same30 seats/cell, same role/opportunity and individual/team type; 3 individual and2 team pairs as a pilot assumption
pilot.interpretation: comparison of whole mechanism with discretionary decision at same ex-ante per-cell fund; cannot isolate effect of admission scarcity or predict bank-wide CSI, and5 pairs may lack statistical power
pilot.decision_targets: provisional:80% correct understanding,90% confirmed receipt by chosen due date,<=2% audited erroneous awards,HR<=220h/month, no material quality harm; commit before results, not bank facts
